title: Files API 3.0 will soon be generally available
body:
Files API 3.0 for Unity Catalog volumes will soon be generally available. Starting in December 2026, it will also be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

The Files API supports reading, writing, listing, and deleting files and directories in Unity Catalog volumes by path. Version 3.0 adds multipart uploads for files larger than 5 GB and conditional operations that prevent unintended changes by checking the current file version before upload, download, or deletion.

See [Use the Files API with Unity Catalog volumes](/aws/en/volumes/files-api) for more information.
